exposure: Obstetric massive transfusion (received > 3 U of pRBC within 1 h or > 10 U in 24 h)
cohort: 610 obstetric patients who received transfusion within 24 hours
finding: Patients over 35 years and those with abnormal placentation are at increased risk of requiring massive transfusion.
mod_finding: Cesarean section history was higher in the massive transfusion group, and patients with abnormal placentation are at increased risk of requiring massive transfusion.
